sections.text: Swiss voters overwhelmingly rejected a proposal backed by the Swiss People's Party (SVP) to enshrine a stricter definition of armed neutrality into the constitution. sections.text: The vote allows Switzerland to continue cooperating with Nato and maintaining sanctions against Russia following its invasion of Ukraine. sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The Guardian has published a physics puzzle originally posed by Isaac Newton in 1679. The puzzle asks where an object dropped from a high tower will land, taking the Earth's rotation into account.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The correspondence between Newton and Robert Hooke about this problem rekindled Newton's interest in gravity and motion. This ultimately led to his formulation of classical physics in the Principia. The puzzle was suggested by David Acheson, an emeritus professor of maths at Oxford.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The solution to the puzzle will be published at 5pm UK time.

sections.text: Taylor Swift, Madonna, and LISA won major prizes at the MTV Video Music Awards on Sunday night in downtown Los Angeles. Madonna performed at the event for the first time in over two decades, winning artist of the year among other prizes. Taylor Swift claimed the top prize for video of the year and received the first Artist Director Honor.
